observations: Three photos show portable speakers in different colors: green (photo 0), beige wrapped in plastic (photo 1), and beige unwrapped (photo 2).
All units have a similar rugged, rectangular design with a handle on top and a front grille with an oval speaker mesh.
The brand 'TURTLEBOX' is visible on the front grille in photo 1 and photo 2.
Photo 1 shows the speaker wrapped in plastic with a hole in the top, possibly from a handle or damage.
Photo 0 shows a green unit with a white handle and control panel with power and volume buttons; no brand visible.
Photo 2 shows a beige unit with a black handle and control panel; brand 'TURTLEBOX' is clearly readable on the grille.
All units appear to be the same model, differing only in color and condition (wrapped vs unwrapped).

claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1, and 2 show three units in different colors (green, beige wrapped, beige unwrapped), confirming availability in multiple colors.

risks.risk: Unit may be non-functional or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the speaker turned on with sound output, or a photo of the power indicator lit and volume controls working.

risks.risk: The wrapped unit (photo 1) may have damage from the hole in the plastic or the unit itself.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the top of the wrapped unit showing whether the hole is in the plastic or the speaker casing, and if there is any damage to the casing or internal components.

risks.risk: Battery or power source may be depleted or faulty.
risks.proof: Photo or video showing the speaker powered on and playing sound, or a photo of the battery compartment or charging port.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the speaker turned on and playing sound.
Close-up of the top of the wrapped unit (photo 1) to check for damage.
Photo of the battery compartment or charging port to confirm power source condition.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a TURTLEBOX portable speaker, and the seller's claim of different colors is supported. However, functionality, internal condition, and power source status are unverified and critical to pricing. Without proof of working condition, the item must be priced as not working or damaged, which requires further evidence.
